steps.what: Show the stored blueprint, drawing, or schematic.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, or reports.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the blueprint, technical drawing, schematic, or report already stored. The mechanical engineer interprets it. The sheet does not say what it means for this machine. A file with no drawing id leaves the reading with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A title was treated as the reading, and the clash on the sheet was still unseen.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored sheet can be opened. The interpretation still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A clash the title does not mention still has to be seen on the sheet.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer interprets the drawing. The file is the sheet already stored.
tasks.altitude: Interpretation stays with the engineer. Opening the sheet does not replace the reading.

reach.task: Issue the drawing that is about to be read.
reach.learn: A file name is not the interpretation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored blueprint, drawing, schematic, or report is a lookup. It does not interpret the sheet.
A computer-generated report is still a document the engineer has to read. The title is not the reading.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The drawing id already stored. The interpretation is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the sheet in the document store before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether blueprints and computer-generated reports share one record type.
research_questions: Who marks a drawing as the current sheet for this machine?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the drawing or report stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop sheets whose machine record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still reads and interprets the blueprint, drawing, schematic, or report. Only opening a sheet that was already stored is removed. A title saves none of the interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored requirement for this mechanical product.
Research, design, install, or maintain mechanical equipment.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the requirement already written for this mechanical product, equipment, system, or process. The mechanical engineer researches, designs, evaluates, installs, operates, or maintains it. The requirement does not do that work. A requirement with no id leaves the work with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Installers started from a requirement that named a different machine.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored requirement can be opened. The research, design, install, and maintenance still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A condition the requirement does not name still has to be handled on the machine.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does the mechanical work. The requirement is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Research, design, installation, operation, and maintenance stay with the engineer. The stored requirement is only visible.

reach.task: Install from a requirement this engineer is still responsible for.
reach.learn: A requirement title is not the installation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored requirement is a lookup. It does not research, design, install, operate, or maintain the equipment.
Installation and maintenance are physical work. The requirement does not do them.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The requirement id already stored. The screen does not mark the equipment installed or maintained. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the requirement in the document store before the work.
unknowns: Whether product requirements and process requirements share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the requirement is the one for this machine?

already_counted.description: The mechanical research, design, install, and maintenance stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop requirements whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still researches, designs, evaluates, installs, operates, or maintains the mechanical product. Only opening a requirement that was already written is removed. A requirement with no id saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored duty and the component already named.
Specify components or direct modification for conformance with specifications.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the duty and any component already named. The mechanical engineer specifies the component or directs the modification so the product conforms to the design, the performance specification, or the environmental regulation. The record does not choose the component. Only the specification the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A component was named on a duty that belonged to a different product.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored duty can be opened. The specification and the direction still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A regulation the duty does not quote still has to be applied by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer specifies the component and directs the modification. The duty is not that choice.
tasks.altitude: The specification stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Modify a product only from a specification this engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A duty line is not the specification.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored duty is a lookup. It does not specify a component or direct a modification.
Filing a specification before the engineer accepts that version would store a choice nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The duty id already stored. The specification text and the regulation judgement are not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the duty in the document store before writing the specification.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether performance specifications and environmental regulations are stored on the same duty.
research_questions: Who confirms which regulation applies to this product?

already_counted.description: Specifying the component and directing the modification stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop duties whose product record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: duty id, component id, and the specification sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still specifies the component or directs the modification, including conformance with the design and the regulation. Only opening the stored duty, and filing the specification already accepted, is removed. A duty line saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored note of this system malfunction.
Confer with engineers to resolve malfunctions or implement procedures.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the malfunction note already written. The mechanical engineer confers with other engineers or personnel to implement the operating procedure, resolve the malfunction, or give the technical information. The note is not that conversation. A note with no caller leaves the conference with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A procedure was marked implemented because a note existed, and the people had not conferred.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored note can be opened. The conference still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A malfunction the note does not describe still has to be heard in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer confers and resolves the trouble. The note is the record already written.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays with the people in the room. The stored note is visible and is not the resolution.

reach.task: Bring the operating procedure that is actually in use.
reach.learn: A malfunction title is not the conference.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored malfunction note is a lookup. It does not confer, resolve the malfunction, or implement the procedure.
Technical information given in the conversation is not the same as the note already stored.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The malfunction id and the note already written. The screen does not mark the malfunction resolved. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the note in the document store before the conference.
unknowns: Whether operating procedures and malfunction notes share one record.
research_questions: Who must be in the conference before a malfunction is called resolved?

already_counted.description: The conference and the resolution stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still confers with the other people to implement the procedure, resolve the malfunction, or give the technical information. Only opening a note that was already written is removed. A note with no caller saves none of the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still interprets the drawing, still does the mechanical work, still specifies the component, and still confers with the other people. A stored sheet can be opened. It does not do the job.
reach: Drafters issue a drawing, and this job learns the sheet is not the interpretation.
Production leads hear a specification only after this engineer has accepted it.
skills_to_grow: Interpret the drawing, rather than treating the title as the reading.
Specify a component only after the duty it must meet is clear.
Confer about a malfunction in the conversation, not from a status line.
role.ambitious_version: Interpretation, mechanical work, component choices, and the conference stay with the engineer. A stored drawing or note only shows what was already written.
